_comment: Example project taxonomy for the MS6 review queue.
Copy to taxonomy.local.json (gitignored) and replace with your own projects.
Ordered: FIRST MATCH WINS — put specific buckets above general ones.
Each alternative sits inside \b...\b, so a prefix token needs an explicit \w*.
A whole-word token is deliberate: '\bmount\b' will not fire on 'mounting'.
'overrides' maps an exact thread slug to a bucket and is consulted BEFORE the rules,
so a one-off correction does not need a regex. 'display_names' gives a bucket the
readable name that entity extraction uses for the episode's project.
One bucket per project: do not give the same effort two buckets (e.g. 'jobs' and 'job-search').
With no taxonomy file present, every episode classifies as 'misc'.
